title.zh-CN: 口渴多尿、恶心呕吐 · 24岁男性

summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻男性口渴、尿多几天后又开始呕吐，来到急诊：先处理眼前的危险，再沿着他的病程完成住院和随访阶段的评估。
summary.en: A young man reaches the emergency department after days of thirst and passing large amounts of urine, now vomiting: deal with the immediate danger, then follow his course through the ward and his follow-up visits.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——24岁男性，口渴多尿 5 天、恶心呕吐 3 天；到院查体与生命体征；急诊血糖、尿糖尿酮、血气和电解质肾功能；补液和胰岛素 12 小时后的血气；次日起胰岛素泵治疗；入院次日 HbA1c、酸中毒纠正后及 2 周、3 个月的 C 肽，3 个月 HbA1c；胰岛自身抗体；多次血常规、HbA2 和珠蛋白基因结果——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；1.0.0 版没有记录的内容（体重身高、意识、血酮、氯、心电图、胰酶、治疗方案细节、MCV 数值等）保持未知。保留的不一致：1.0.0 版注明报告中 MCV 的单位指数前后不一致，本例不换算其数值；“既往无糖尿病诊断”的表述既可理解为明确否认，也可理解为未提及，列入待核实。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 24-year-old man with five days of thirst and polyuria and three days of nausea and vomiting; the presenting examination and vital signs; the emergency glucose, urine glucose and ketones, blood gas and renal and electrolyte values; the blood gas 12 hours after fluids and insulin; insulin-pump treatment from the next day; the next-day HbA1c, the C-peptide after correction of the acidosis and at two weeks and three months, and the three-month HbA1c; the islet antibodies; the repeated blood counts, HbA2 and the globin gene result — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record (weight and height, conscious level, blood ketones, chloride, ECG, pancreatic enzymes, the treatment regimen, the MCV value and more) stays unknown. Kept as found: 1.0.0 notes that the report's unit exponent for the MCV is inconsistent, so no MCV value is converted; its statement that the report gives no previous diabetes diagnosis can be read as a recorded negative or as a silence, and is listed to verify.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据血糖、酮体和酸碱结果诊断糖尿病酮症酸中毒，并按 2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识分级、决定治疗地点；不因没有烂苹果味或呕吐突出而误判为胃肠炎。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose diabetic ketoacidosis from glucose, ketone and acid–base results and grade it, with the level of care, by the 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus — without being misled by the absent fruity breath or the prominent vomiting.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 第一小时开始等渗补液和 0.1 U/(kg·h) 固定速率静脉胰岛素；血钾 6.23 mmol/L 时在心电监护下暂不补钾，降至 5.0–5.5 mmol/L 以下再补；pH 7.17 时不用碳酸氢钠（2024 年共识；JBDS-IP 2023）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start isotonic fluid and a fixed-rate intravenous insulin infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h in the first hour, withhold potassium at 6.23 mmol/L under ECG monitoring until it falls below 5.0–5.5 mmol/L, and give no bicarbonate at pH 7.17 (2024 consensus; JBDS-IP 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 计算血钠 117.05 mmol/L、血糖 23.8 mmol/L 时的校正血钠和有效渗透压，据此选择等渗液体并安排血钠监测（2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Calculate the glucose-corrected sodium and the effective osmolality for Na⁺ 117.05 mmol/L with glucose 23.8 mmol/L, and choose isotonic fluid and plan sodium monitoring from them (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 确认酮症酸中毒已纠正（血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L，且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L），停静脉胰岛素前 1–2 小时先皮下注射基础胰岛素（2024 年共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Confirm that ketoacidosis has resolved (ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L) and give subcutaneous basal insulin 1–2 hours before stopping the infusion (2024 consensus).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 应用日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准诊断暴发性 1 型糖尿病，并与经典自身免疫性 1 型、酮症倾向 2 型和单基因糖尿病鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria to diagnose fulminant type 1 diabetes and distinguish it from classic autoimmune type 1, ketosis-prone type 2 and monogenic diabetes.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明 β 地中海贫血携带状态为何可能使 HbA1c 失真，改用血糖监测、糖化白蛋白或果糖胺评估控制；不在未证实缺铁时补铁，并提供携带者咨询和配偶检测（ADA 2026；BSH 2023）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why β-thalassaemia trait can make HbA1c unreliable, judge control by glucose monitoring, glycated albumin or fructosamine instead, give no iron without proven deficiency, and offer carrier counselling and partner testing (ADA 2026; BSH 2023).

triageNote.zh-CN: 24岁男性，口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天，急性病容。分诊手测：体温 36.7 ℃，脉搏 106 次/分，呼吸 25 次/分，血压 106/59 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 24-year-old man with five days of thirst and polyuria and three days of nausea and vomiting; looks acutely unwell. Triage readings: T 36.7 °C, pulse 106/min, RR 25/min, BP 106/59 mmHg.

personality.zh-CN: 24岁男性，这几天口渴、尿多，又吐了三天，病着、心里有点怕；问一句答一句，话很短。他只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 24-year-old man, ill after days of thirst and passing urine and three days of being sick, and a little frightened; he answers what he is asked in few words, says only what he knows, and when he doesn't know he says so rather than guess.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、简短，不会说医学名词；一句话常常只说半句。
speechStyle.en: Short, everyday words and no medical terms; often answers in half a sentence.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这几天老是口渴、尿多，这三天又恶心、吐。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've been thirsty and peeing loads for days, and for three days I've been feeling sick and throwing up.

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我是不是吃坏肚子了？
concerns.en: Doctor, is it just a stomach bug?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：急诊时他躺在推床上，呼吸偏快，回答简短，对抽血、输液有些紧张；到病房和随访时，病例没有写他的感受，被问到“现在怎么样”就说说不上来。只回答被问到的内容；不提化验结果或任何数字，不编造病史、用药、过敏或家族史。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: in the ED he lies on the trolley breathing fast, answers briefly and is uneasy about the drips and blood tests; on the ward and at follow-up nothing is written about how he feels, so asked how he is now he says he isn't sure. He answers only what he is asked, never mentions results or numbers, and never invents history, medicines, allergies or family history.

description.zh-CN: 24岁男性，口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天，刚被送进急诊抢救区，看上去病得不轻：问诊、查体、做床旁和化验检查，决定第一小时的处理。
description.en: A 24-year-old man with five days of thirst and polyuria and three days of nausea and vomiting has just been brought into the ED resus area looking acutely unwell: take the history, examine him, get the bedside and laboratory tests and decide the first hour of treatment.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：24岁男性，口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天就诊。急性病容，皮肤干燥、弹性差，BMI 17.62 kg/m²；体温 36.7 ℃，脉搏 106 次/分，呼吸 25 次/分，血压 106/59 mmHg；呼出气无烂苹果味，心肺无明显异常。血糖 23.8 mmol/L，尿糖 ++++、尿酮体 +++；pH 7.173，HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L，BE −21.6 mmol/L；钠 117.05 mmol/L，钾 6.23 mmol/L，肌酐 179 μmol/L。补液和胰岛素治疗 12 小时后 pH 7.375、HCO₃⁻ 20 mmol/L；次日开始胰岛素泵治疗。入院次日 HbA1c 6.8%；酸中毒纠正后空腹/餐后 2 小时 C 肽 50/70 pmol/L，2 周 80/100 pmol/L，3 个月 60/170 pmol/L；GAD、ICA、IAA 均阴性。此后多次血常规血红蛋白 110.7–126 g/L，持续小细胞性；HbA2 4.6%；β 珠蛋白基因第 17 位密码子杂合突变。报告的诊断为暴发性 1 型糖尿病合并 β 地中海贫血。3 个月时 HbA1c 6.9%，C 肽仍低。本病例没有记录治疗方案细节、远期并发症、更完整的免疫分型和 3 个月以后的情况。
text.en: Recorded course: a 24-year-old man presented with five days of thirst and polyuria and three days of nausea and vomiting. He looked acutely unwell, with dry skin and reduced turgor, BMI 17.62 kg/m²; temperature 36.7 °C, pulse 106/min, respiratory rate 25/min, blood pressure 106/59 mmHg; no fruity breath, and no obvious abnormality of the heart or lungs. Glucose 23.8 mmol/L, urine glucose ++++ and ketones +++; pH 7.173, bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L, base excess −21.6 mmol/L; sodium 117.05 mmol/L, potassium 6.23 mmol/L, creatinine 179 μmol/L. Twelve hours after fluids and insulin, pH was 7.375 and bicarbonate 20 mmol/L; insulin-pump treatment began the next day. HbA1c the day after admission was 6.8 %; fasting/2-hour post-meal C-peptide was 50/70 pmol/L after the acidosis was corrected, 80/100 pmol/L at two weeks and 60/170 pmol/L at three months; GAD, ICA and IAA antibodies were negative. Repeated blood counts showed haemoglobin 110.7–126 g/L with persistent microcytosis; HbA2 was 4.6 % and he was heterozygous for a β-globin gene codon 17 variant. The report's diagnosis was fulminant type 1 diabetes with β-thalassaemia. At three months HbA1c was 6.9 % and the C-peptide remained low. This case does not record the treatment regimen, long-term complications, any fuller immune classification or anything after three months.

response.zh-CN: 胰岛素在泵入。报告记录给了胰岛素，没有记录途径和剂量；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. The report records that he was given insulin, but not its route or dose; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 每小时测指尖血糖和血酮；开始治疗后 1–2 小时复查血钾、pH 和 HCO₃⁻，之后每 2–4 小时一次（血钾低于 5.0–5.5 mmol/L 时开始按量补钾）；每 2–4 小时查血钠并计算校正值；记录出入量和尿量；观察神志。
dose.en: Hourly fingerprick glucose and ketones; potassium, pH and bicarbonate 1–2 hours after treatment starts and then every 2–4 hours (potassium replacement once it falls below 5.0–5.5 mmol/L); sodium every 2–4 hours with its glucose-corrected value; fluid balance and urine output; neurological observations.

response.zh-CN: 计划已写入医嘱。本病例只显示报告记录的数值，不模拟其他读数。
response.en: Charted. The case shows only the values the report records, in their phases, and does not simulate the others.

name.zh-CN: 请上级医师评估并转入高依赖或重症病房
name.en: Senior review and referral for high-dependency or intensive care

dose.zh-CN: 请上级医师床旁评估，联系高依赖病房（HDU）或重症监护病房，安排有持续监护的床位。
dose.en: Ask a senior to review at the bedside and contact the high-dependency unit (HDU) or intensive care for a continuously monitored bed.

response.zh-CN: 已联系。本病例没有记录他在哪里接受治疗，也没有记录是否请求了这类床位。
response.en: Referral made. This case does not record where he was treated or whether such a bed was requested.

name.zh-CN: 静脉液体中加入氯化钾
name.en: Potassium chloride added to the IV fluid

dose.zh-CN: 每升静脉液体中加入氯化钾 40 mmol。
dose.en: Potassium chloride 40 mmol added to each litre of IV fluid.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例记录的唯一一次血钾是 6.23 mmol/L（肌酐 179 μmol/L）：按这个数值加钾可能诱发危险的心律失常。2024 年共识在复查血钾降到 5.0 mmol/L 以下才开始补钾（JBDS-IP 2023 为 5.5 mmol/L），并在心电监护下按复查结果调整；补液和胰岛素会让血钾下降。
harm.en: The only potassium this case records is 6.23 mmol/L, with a creatinine of 179 μmol/L: adding potassium against it risks a dangerous arrhythmia. The 2024 consensus starts replacement only once a repeat potassium is below 5.0 mmol/L (5.5 mmol/L in JBDS-IP 2023), adjusted to repeat values under ECG monitoring; fluids and insulin bring it down.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

harm.zh-CN: pH 7.173 高于 7.0：2024 年共识只在 pH < 7.0 时考虑碳酸氢钠。它不能加快恢复，却会在胰岛素起效后加重低钾、增加钠负荷；纠正酸中毒靠补液和胰岛素。
harm.en: pH 7.173 is above 7.0: the 2024 consensus considers bicarbonate only below pH 7.0. It does not speed recovery, but it worsens hypokalaemia once insulin acts and adds a sodium load; fluids and insulin correct the acidosis.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.45% 氯化钠 1 L 静脉输注。

harm.zh-CN: 他的血钠 117.05 mmol/L，按血糖校正后约 122–125 mmol/L，有效渗透压约 258 mOsm/kg——是低张状态，不是高渗。低渗液会让血钠和渗透压进一步下降，增加脑水肿风险；2024 年共识先用等渗液，此后的液体按血钠选择。
harm.en: His sodium is 117.05 mmol/L — about 122–125 mmol/L once corrected for glucose — and his effective osmolality about 258 mOsm/kg: he is hypotonic, not hyperosmolar. A hypotonic fluid lowers the sodium and osmolality further and adds to the risk of cerebral oedema; the 2024 consensus starts with isotonic fluid and chooses later fluids by the sodium.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 普通病房皮下注射速效胰岛素（代替静脉输注）
name.en: Subcutaneous rapid-acting insulin on a general ward (instead of an infusion)

dose.zh-CN: 速效胰岛素类似物每 1–2 小时皮下注射，配合口服补液，在普通病房处理。
dose.en: A rapid-acting insulin analogue subcutaneously every 1–2 hours with oral rehydration, managed on a general ward.

harm.zh-CN: 2024 年共识只把皮下速效胰岛素用于无并发症的轻中度酮症酸中毒；他的 HCO₃⁻ 在重度范围，血钾 6.23、血钠 117.05 mmol/L、肌酐 179 μmol/L，又在呕吐，需要在有监护的床位静脉补液并用固定速率静脉胰岛素。
harm.en: The 2024 consensus keeps subcutaneous rapid-acting insulin for uncomplicated mild or moderate ketoacidosis; his bicarbonate is in the severe band, his potassium 6.23 and sodium 117.05 mmol/L, his creatinine 179 μmol/L, and he is vomiting — he needs intravenous fluids and a fixed-rate intravenous insulin infusion in a monitored bed.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 长效（基础）胰岛素皮下注射，约为按体重估算的每日总量的一半，在停静脉胰岛素前 1–2 小时给予；之后配合餐时胰岛素（基础–餐时方案）。
dose.en: Long-acting (basal) insulin subcutaneously — about half of a weight-based estimate of the total daily dose — given 1–2 hours before the infusion stops, then with mealtime insulin (a basal–bolus regimen).

response.zh-CN: 已注射。报告记录次日开始胰岛素泵治疗，没有记录他怎样撤离静脉胰岛素；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The report records insulin-pump treatment from the next day, not how he came off the infusion; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 在皮下基础胰岛素注射 1–2 小时后停止静脉胰岛素输注。
dose.en: Stop the intravenous insulin 1–2 hours after the first subcutaneous basal insulin.

harm.zh-CN: 还没有任何皮下胰岛素在起作用就停输注，等于让他完全没有胰岛素：刚以酮症酸中毒起病的糖尿病，几个小时内就可能再次酸中毒。2024 年共识要求先给基础胰岛素，1–2 小时后再停。
harm.en: Stopping before any subcutaneous insulin is working leaves him with no insulin at all: in diabetes that has just presented in ketoacidosis, ketoacidosis can return within hours. The 2024 consensus gives basal insulin first and stops the infusion 1–2 hours later.

response.zh-CN: 静脉胰岛素已停。本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is stopped. The case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 启用胰岛素泵（持续皮下胰岛素输注）
name.en: Start an insulin pump (continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion)

dose.zh-CN: 由熟悉胰岛素泵的团队设置基础率和餐前大剂量，持续皮下输注速效胰岛素，并教会他使用和应对故障。
dose.en: Rapid-acting insulin by continuous subcutaneous infusion with basal rates and meal boluses, set up by a team experienced with pumps, who also teach him to use it and to handle a failure.

harm.zh-CN: 酮症酸中毒时胰岛素要静脉输注：2024 年共识把中重度酮症酸中毒交给固定速率静脉胰岛素，酸中毒纠正后再转为皮下给药。
harm.en: In ketoacidosis insulin goes intravenously: the 2024 consensus treats moderate and severe ketoacidosis with a fixed-rate intravenous infusion and moves to subcutaneous insulin only once it has resolved.

response.zh-CN: 泵已启用。报告记录次日开始胰岛素泵治疗，没有记录参数、剂量和教育内容；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The pump is running. The report records insulin-pump treatment from the next day, but not its settings, doses or the education given; the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 只按血糖追加速效胰岛素（不用基础胰岛素）
name.en: Correction doses of rapid-acting insulin only (no basal insulin)

dose.zh-CN: 只在血糖超过 11 mmol/L 时按读数给速效胰岛素，不用基础胰岛素。
dose.en: Rapid-acting insulin only when glucose is above 11 mmol/L, dosed by the reading, with no basal insulin.

harm.zh-CN: 只按血糖追加不提供基础胰岛素，两次注射之间酮体会再升高。2024 年共识在酮症酸中毒纠正后改用基础–餐时方案，基础胰岛素在停输注前 1–2 小时给予。
harm.en: Correction doses alone give no basal insulin, so ketones rise again between doses. After ketoacidosis the 2024 consensus moves to a basal–bolus regimen, with basal insulin given 1–2 hours before the infusion stops.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 口服降糖药（如二甲双胍）代替胰岛素
name.en: Oral glucose-lowering tablets (such as metformin) instead of insulin

dose.zh-CN: 停胰岛素，改为二甲双胍等口服降糖药。
dose.en: Stop insulin and switch to oral glucose-lowering tablets such as metformin.

harm.zh-CN: 刚以酮症酸中毒起病的糖尿病要用胰岛素：2024 年共识在酮症酸中毒后转为基础–餐时胰岛素方案。口服药不能替代胰岛素，停用胰岛素可能让酮症酸中毒再次发生。
harm.en: Diabetes that has just presented in ketoacidosis is treated with insulin: after ketoacidosis the 2024 consensus moves to a basal–bolus insulin regimen. Tablets do not replace insulin, and stopping it risks a return of ketoacidosis.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服铁剂（如硫酸亚铁）每日一次。
dose.en: An oral iron supplement (such as ferrous sulfate) once daily.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例没有显示缺铁——没有记录铁蛋白或其他铁代谢指标。铁剂只用于证实的缺铁；没有缺铁时补铁什么也纠正不了，只会增加体内铁。先查铁蛋白（BSH 2023）。
harm.en: No iron deficiency is shown in this case — no ferritin or other iron studies are recorded. Iron is for proven deficiency; without it, iron corrects nothing and only adds to the body's iron. Check ferritin first (BSH 2023).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 转诊遗传咨询，给他书面结果；建议将来配偶在怀孕前检测，并为亲属提供检测。
dose.en: Referral for genetic counselling, with his results in writing; partner testing offered before a pregnancy, and testing offered to his relatives.

response.zh-CN: 已转诊。本病例没有记录遗传咨询或家属检测；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referral made. This case records no genetic counselling or family testing; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 自我管理教育（胰岛素、病假规则和酮体监测）
name.en: Self-management education (insulin, sick-day rules and ketone checks)

dose.zh-CN: 由糖尿病专科团队进行：胰岛素注射与调整、血糖监测、低血糖识别与处理（含胰高糖素）、生病时不停胰岛素并监测血酮、何时就医。
dose.en: By the diabetes specialist team: insulin injection and adjustment, glucose monitoring, recognising and treating hypoglycaemia (including glucagon), never stopping insulin when ill and checking ketones, and when to seek help.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录他接受了哪些教育；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record the education he received; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 佩戴持续葡萄糖监测探头，用葡萄糖目标范围内时间等指标评估控制，并教会他看懂读数。
dose.en: A continuous glucose monitoring sensor, judging control by time in range and related metrics, with teaching on reading it.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录是否使用 CGM；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record whether a CGM was used; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 先看病人：病史与床旁评估
title.en: See the patient: history and bedside assessment

hint.zh-CN: 这五天里哪些症状先出现、哪些后出现？他的呼吸、脉搏、血压和皮肤，告诉你他病得有多重？
hint.en: Over these five days, what came first and what came later — and what do his breathing, pulse, blood pressure and skin tell you about how ill he is?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清口渴、尿多和呕吐的经过，以前有没有糖尿病，家里有没有人得糖尿病；测生命体征，看一般情况和脱水程度，闻一闻呼出气。
guidance.en: At the bedside, take the story of the thirst, the urine and the vomiting, ask about any diabetes before and in his family; take his vital signs, look at his general state and hydration, and smell his breath.

title.en: Emergency tests and a working diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 哪几项一小时内就能出结果的检查，可以同时解释他的口渴、呕吐和呼吸加快？
hint.en: Which tests, back within the hour, could explain his thirst, his vomiting and his fast breathing all at once?

guidance.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路并采血，查血糖、尿常规、血气和肾功能电解质，读完结果后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Place a cannula and take bloods; get the glucose, urinalysis, blood gas and kidney function with electrolytes, read them, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 补液、胰岛素和钾，各自什么时候开始、按什么顺序？这份血钾和这份血钠会改变你的选择吗？
hint.en: Fluids, insulin and potassium: which starts when, and in what order — and do this potassium and this sodium change your choices?

guidance.zh-CN: 到会诊板作答决策 2，再回到床旁把计划落实：开始补液和胰岛素，安排监测。动手之后，病例才进入治疗 12 小时后的阶段。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, then put the plan into action at the bedside: start the fluid and the insulin and set up monitoring. The case moves on to the 12-hour mark once you have acted.

title.zh-CN: 治疗 12 小时后的下一步
title.en: The next step at twelve hours

hint.zh-CN: 复查结果出来后，哪些结果才能说明危机真的过去了？停掉静脉用药之前，什么必须已经在起作用？
hint.en: When the repeat results are back, which of them would tell you the crisis is really over — and what must already be working before the drip comes down?

guidance.zh-CN: 复查血气并阅读结果，作答决策 3，然后落实撤离静脉胰岛素的第一步。
guidance.en: Repeat the blood gas and read it, answer decision 3, then take the first step off the intravenous insulin.

title.zh-CN: 病房：住院化验与长期计划
title.en: On the ward: inpatient tests and the long-term plan

hint.zh-CN: 血糖很高、症状却只有几天时，你预期 HbA1c 会怎样？哪些证据根本不依赖 HbA1c？
hint.en: With a very high glucose but only days of symptoms, what would you expect the HbA1c to show — and which evidence does not depend on HbA1c at all?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端或床旁查看 HbA1c、C 肽和胰岛自身抗体，作答决策 4；再看多次复查的血常规及由此做的化验，作答决策 5，并安排教育和随访。
guidance.en: Read the HbA1c, C-peptide and islet antibodies at a records terminal or the bedside and answer decision 4; then the repeated blood counts and the tests they lead to, answer decision 5, and arrange education and follow-up.

title.en: Follow-up at two weeks and three months

hint.zh-CN: 他自己的胰岛素分泌后来怎样了？3 个月时的 HbA1c 能直接拿来评价控制吗？
hint.en: What happened to his own insulin secretion — and can the three-month HbA1c be taken at face value?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看随访时的 C 肽和 HbA1c，以及记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the follow-up C-peptide and HbA1c, and the recorded course and outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天。脉搏 106 次/分，呼吸 25 次/分，血压 106/59 mmHg，皮肤干燥、弹性差，呼出气没有烂苹果味。血糖 23.8 mmol/L；尿糖 ++++，尿酮体 +++；pH 7.173，HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L，BE −21.6 mmol/L；钾 6.23 mmol/L，钠 117.05 mmol/L，肌酐 179 μmol/L。你的工作诊断是什么？他应该在哪里治疗？
prompt.en: Five days of thirst and polyuria, three days of nausea and vomiting. Pulse 106/min, RR 25/min, BP 106/59 mmHg, dry skin with reduced turgor, no fruity smell on his breath. Glucose 23.8 mmol/L; urine glucose ++++, ketones +++; pH 7.173, bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L, base excess −21.6 mmol/L; K⁺ 6.23 mmol/L, Na⁺ 117.05 mmol/L, creatinine 179 μmol/L. What is your working diagnosis, and where should he be treated?

need.zh-CN: 先问清口渴和呕吐的经过，测生命体征、看脱水、闻呼出气，并读血糖、尿常规、血气和肾功能电解质的结果。
need.en: First take the thirst and vomiting history, check his vital signs, hydration and breath, and read the glucose, urinalysis, blood gas and kidney function with electrolytes.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒，HCO₃⁻ 已在重度范围，合并高钾、低钠和肌酐升高：收入有持续监护的高依赖或重症病房
text.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis with bicarbonate in the severe band, high potassium, low sodium and a raised creatinine: a monitored high-dependency or intensive care bed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 高血糖危象共识的诊断要素是血糖 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L（或已知糖尿病）、酮症（β-羟丁酸 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L；JBDS-IP 2023 也接受尿酮体 ++ 及以上）和酸中毒（pH < 7.3 和/或 HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L）。他的 pH 7.173 属中度，HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L 却已低于重度界值 10 mmol/L；共识建议中度在过渡监护病房、重度在重症监护病房治疗，而高钾、低钠和肌酐升高都要求持续监护和频繁复查。
feedback.en: Correct. The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus defines DKA by glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L (or known diabetes), ketosis (β-hydroxybutyrate ≥ 3.0 mmol/L; JBDS-IP 2023 also accepts urine ketones ++ or more) and acidosis (pH < 7.3 and/or bicarbonate < 18 mmol/L). His pH of 7.173 is in the moderate band but his bicarbonate of 7.1 mmol/L is below the severe cut-off of 10 mmol/L; the consensus treats moderate DKA in step-down care and severe DKA in intensive care, and his potassium, sodium and creatinine all call for continuous monitoring and frequent rechecks.

text.zh-CN: 轻度糖尿病酮症酸中毒：呼出气没有烂苹果味、血压还能维持、pH 在 7.1 以上，可以在普通病房皮下注射胰岛素
text.en: Mild diabetic ketoacidosis: no fruity breath, a blood pressure that is holding and a pH above 7.1, so subcutaneous insulin on a general ward

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年共识的轻度标准是 pH > 7.25 且 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 15 mmol/L、神志正常；他的 pH 7.173、HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L 远不符合。呼气烂苹果味是靠不住的体征，闻不到不能排除任何东西；皮下速效胰岛素只用于无并发症的轻中度酮症酸中毒。
feedback.en: No. The 2024 consensus defines mild DKA as pH > 7.25 and bicarbonate ≥ 15 mmol/L with normal mental status; his pH of 7.173 and bicarbonate of 7.1 mmol/L are far outside it. A fruity smell on the breath is a soft sign whose absence excludes nothing, and subcutaneous rapid-acting insulin is only for uncomplicated mild or moderate DKA.

text.zh-CN: 急性胃肠炎伴脱水和肾前性肾损伤：血糖和酮体升高是应激和饥饿造成的，补足液体后会自行回落
text.en: Acute gastroenteritis with dehydration and pre-renal kidney injury; the glucose and ketones are stress and starvation effects that will settle once he is rehydrated

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。呕吐本身就是糖尿病酮症酸中毒的常见症状，而胃肠炎解释不了血糖 23.8 mmol/L、尿酮体 +++ 和 HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L 同时出现。把酮症酸中毒当作“胃肠炎”是延误治疗的常见原因：按 2024 年共识的诊断标准，年轻人呕吐伴口渴多尿就要马上查血糖和酮体。
feedback.en: No. Vomiting is a common symptom of DKA itself, and gastroenteritis does not explain a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L with ketonuria +++ and a bicarbonate of 7.1 mmol/L together. Calling ketoacidosis 'gastroenteritis' is a well-worn route to delay: by the 2024 consensus criteria, a young adult who is vomiting after days of thirst and polyuria needs glucose and ketones checked at once.

text.zh-CN: 饥饿性酮症：一个偏瘦的年轻人呕吐 3 天进食减少，先输含葡萄糖的液体，暂不用胰岛素
text.en: Starvation ketosis after three days of vomiting in an underweight young man: rehydrate with glucose-containing fluid and hold the insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。饥饿性酮症只有轻度酮症，血糖正常或偏低，HCO₃⁻ 只轻度下降；它不可能造成血糖 23.8 mmol/L 伴 pH 7.173、HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L。此时不用胰岛素会让酸中毒继续加重——按 2024 年共识，这是需要静脉胰岛素的糖尿病酮症酸中毒。
feedback.en: No. Starvation ketosis gives mild ketosis with a normal or low glucose and only a modest fall in bicarbonate; it cannot produce a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L with pH 7.173 and bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L. Holding insulin would let the acidosis deepen — by the 2024 consensus this is DKA needing intravenous insulin.

text.zh-CN: 高渗性高血糖状态：先单纯补液，等血糖不再随补液下降时再加胰岛素
text.en: Hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state: give fluids alone first, adding insulin only once the glucose stops falling with fluids

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年共识中的高渗性高血糖状态以显著高血糖（≥ 33.3 mmol/L）、有效渗透压 > 300 mOsm/kg、酮症和酸中毒不明显为特征；他的血糖 23.8 mmol/L，有效渗透压（2 × 钠 + 血糖）只有约 258 mOsm/kg，而尿酮体 +++、pH 7.173。糖尿病酮症酸中毒推迟胰岛素只会延长酸中毒。
feedback.en: No. In the 2024 consensus HHS means marked hyperglycaemia (≥ 33.3 mmol/L) with an effective osmolality above 300 mOsm/kg and little ketosis or acidosis; his glucose is 23.8 mmol/L, his effective osmolality (2 × Na⁺ + glucose) only about 258 mOsm/kg, with ketonuria +++ and pH 7.173. Delaying insulin in DKA only prolongs the acidosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 你已判断为糖尿病酮症酸中毒：pH 7.173，HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L，钾 6.23 mmol/L，钠 117.05 mmol/L，肌酐 179 μmol/L，血压 106/59 mmHg；他的体重还不知道。第一小时你开始哪些处理？
prompt.en: You have diagnosed diabetic ketoacidosis: pH 7.173, bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L, K⁺ 6.23 mmol/L, Na⁺ 117.05 mmol/L, creatinine 179 μmol/L, BP 106/59 mmHg; his weight is not yet known. What do you start in the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1（工作诊断和治疗地点）。
need.en: First commit to a working diagnosis and place of care (decision 1).

text.zh-CN: 第 1 小时 0.9% 氯化钠 1 L，胰岛素 0.1 U/(kg·h) 持续静滴；血钾降到 5.0–5.5 mmol/L 以下前不补钾，心电监护并在 2 小时内复查
text.en: 0.9 % saline 1 L in the first hour and insulin by infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h; no potassium until it is below 5.0–5.5 mmol/L, on ECG monitoring with a recheck within 2 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024 年共识：无心肾功能受损时，等渗盐水或平衡晶体液在最初 2–4 小时按 500–1000 mL/h 输注；固定速率胰岛素 0.1 U/(kg·h)；血钾低于 5.0 mmol/L 才开始补钾（JBDS-IP 2023 的界值是 5.5 mmol/L），低于 3.5 mmol/L 时先补钾、推迟胰岛素，开始胰岛素 2 小时后复查血钾。血钾 6.23 mmol/L 加上肌酐升高，需要持续心电监护；病例没有记录心脏或肾脏疾病，肌酐 179 μmol/L 与脱水相符，所以每输完一升都要看尿量、重新评估，后续液体按血钠选择。
feedback.en: Correct. The 2024 consensus gives isotonic saline or a balanced crystalloid at 500–1,000 mL/h for the first 2–4 hours when there is no cardiac or renal compromise, a fixed-rate insulin infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h, potassium only once it is below 5.0 mmol/L (5.5 mmol/L in JBDS-IP 2023), insulin held if potassium is below 3.5 mmol/L, and a potassium check 2 hours after insulin starts. K⁺ 6.23 mmol/L with a raised creatinine means continuous ECG monitoring; no heart or kidney disease is recorded and a creatinine of 179 μmol/L fits volume depletion, so chart his urine output and reassess after each litre, choosing later fluids by his sodium.

text.zh-CN: 第 1 小时 0.9% 氯化钠 1 L 并加氯化钾 40 mmol，因为酮症酸中毒时体内总钾是缺乏的；胰岛素 0.1 U/(kg·h) 持续静滴，2 小时后再复查一次血钾
text.en: 0.9 % saline 1 L with 40 mmol potassium chloride in the first hour, since ketoacidosis depletes total-body potassium, and insulin by infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h with a potassium check at 2 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。酮症酸中毒时总体钾确实缺乏，但此刻血钾 6.23 mmol/L、肌酐 179 μmol/L，第一升就加 40 mmol 钾可能诱发危险的心律失常。2024 年共识在血钾低于 5.0 mmol/L（JBDS-IP 2023：5.5 mmol/L）后才按复查结果补钾；补液和胰岛素会让血钾下降。
feedback.en: No. Total-body potassium is low in DKA, but his serum potassium is 6.23 mmol/L now with a creatinine of 179 μmol/L, and 40 mmol in the first litre risks a dangerous arrhythmia. The 2024 consensus starts replacement once potassium is below 5.0 mmol/L (5.5 mmol/L in JBDS-IP 2023), guided by repeat levels; fluids and insulin will bring it down.

text.zh-CN: 先静脉输注 8.4% 碳酸氢钠，把 pH 提到 7.2 以上再开始胰岛素，因为 HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L 随时可能危及生命
text.en: 8.4 % sodium bicarbonate first to lift the pH above 7.2 before any insulin, because a bicarbonate of 7.1 mmol/L could kill him at any moment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年共识只在 pH < 7.0 时考虑碳酸氢钠；pH 7.173 时它没有益处，反而会在胰岛素起效后加重低钾、增加钠负荷。纠正酸中毒靠补液和胰岛素，胰岛素更不应因此推迟。
feedback.en: No. The 2024 consensus considers bicarbonate only below pH 7.0; at pH 7.173 it brings no benefit, and it worsens hypokalaemia once insulin acts and adds a sodium load. Fluids and insulin correct the acidosis, and insulin should not wait for it.

text.zh-CN: 第 1 小时 0.45% 氯化钠 1 L，因为酮症酸中毒主要丢失的是水；液体开始后胰岛素 0.1 U/(kg·h) 持续静滴
text.en: 0.45 % saline 1 L in the first hour, because ketoacidosis mainly loses water, then insulin by infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h once the fluid is running

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的血钠 117.05 mmol/L，按血糖校正后约 122–125 mmol/L，有效渗透压约 258 mOsm/kg——是低张，而不是高渗。低渗液会让血钠进一步下降、增加脑水肿风险；2024 年共识先用等渗液，此后的液体按血钠选择，2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南也要求先按血糖校正血钠再判断。
feedback.en: No. His sodium is 117.05 mmol/L — about 122–125 mmol/L once corrected for glucose — and his effective osmolality about 258 mOsm/kg: he is hypotonic, not hyperosmolar. A hypotonic fluid would lower the sodium further and add to the risk of cerebral oedema; the 2024 consensus starts with isotonic fluid and chooses later fluids by the sodium, and the 2014 European hyponatraemia guideline corrects the sodium for glucose before interpreting it.

text.zh-CN: 每 1–2 小时皮下注射速效胰岛素，同时口服补液；这样不必静脉输注胰岛素，可以在普通病房处理
text.en: Rapid-acting insulin under the skin every 1–2 hours with oral rehydration, which avoids an insulin infusion and lets a general ward manage him

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年共识只把皮下速效胰岛素用于无并发症的轻中度酮症酸中毒；他的 HCO₃⁻ 在重度范围，血钾 6.23、血钠 117.05 mmol/L、肌酐 179 μmol/L，而且在呕吐，口服补液不现实。他需要在有监护的床位静脉补液，并用固定速率静脉胰岛素。
feedback.en: No. The 2024 consensus keeps subcutaneous rapid-acting insulin for uncomplicated mild or moderate DKA; his bicarbonate is in the severe band, his potassium is 6.23 and sodium 117.05 mmol/L, his creatinine 179 μmol/L, and he is vomiting, so oral rehydration is not realistic. He needs intravenous fluids and a fixed-rate intravenous insulin infusion in a monitored bed.

prompt.zh-CN: 补液和胰岛素治疗 12 小时后，复查血气 pH 7.375，HCO₃⁻ 20 mmol/L。你怎样撤离静脉胰岛素？
prompt.en: Twelve hours into fluids and insulin, his repeat gas shows pH 7.375 and bicarbonate 20 mmol/L. How do you take him off the insulin infusion?

need.zh-CN: 先在这一阶段复查血气并阅读结果。
need.en: First repeat the blood gas in this phase and read it.

text.zh-CN: 先确认血酮低于 0.6 mmol/L、他能进食，皮下注射基础胰岛素，1–2 小时后再停静脉胰岛素
text.en: Check that blood ketones are below 0.6 mmol/L and that he can eat, give subcutaneous basal insulin, and stop the infusion 1–2 hours later

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024 年共识以血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L 且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L 作为纠正标准，并在停输注前至少 1–2 小时给基础胰岛素，随后用基础–餐时方案。他的 pH 和 HCO₃⁻ 已达标，但本病例没有记录血酮，所以要先查。报告中的团队次日开始用胰岛素泵；无论长期用哪种方案，都要等皮下胰岛素起效后再停输注。
feedback.en: Correct. The 2024 consensus defines resolution as blood ketones below 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L, gives basal insulin at least 1–2 hours before the infusion stops, and continues with a basal–bolus regimen. His pH and bicarbonate meet the thresholds, but no ketone value is recorded, so check it. The report's team started an insulin pump the next day; whatever the long-term regimen, the infusion stops only once subcutaneous insulin is working.

text.zh-CN: pH 和 HCO₃⁻ 都已恢复正常，现在就停掉静脉胰岛素，等他吃下一顿饭的时候再开始打皮下胰岛素针
text.en: pH and bicarbonate are back to normal, so stop the infusion now and start his subcutaneous insulin with the next proper meal he manages to eat

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。刚以酮症酸中毒起病的糖尿病，在皮下胰岛素起效之前停输注，等于让他完全没有胰岛素，几个小时内就可能再次酸中毒；pH 和 HCO₃⁻ 正常也不等于酮体已经清除。2024 年共识在停输注前 1–2 小时先给基础胰岛素。
feedback.en: No. In diabetes that has just presented in ketoacidosis, stopping the infusion before subcutaneous insulin is working leaves him with no insulin at all, and ketoacidosis can return within hours; a normal pH and bicarbonate do not show that ketones have cleared. The 2024 consensus gives basal insulin 1–2 hours before the infusion stops.

text.zh-CN: 停静脉胰岛素，之后只在指尖血糖超过 11 mmol/L 时，按每次读数给一次速效胰岛素
text.en: Stop the infusion, then give rapid-acting insulin only when his fingerprick glucose is above 11 mmol/L, dosed by each reading

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。只按血糖追加的速效胰岛素不提供基础胰岛素，两次注射之间酮体会重新升高。2024 年共识在酮症酸中毒纠正后改用基础–餐时方案，基础胰岛素在停输注前 1–2 小时给予。
feedback.en: No. Correction doses alone provide no basal insulin, so ketones climb again between doses. After ketoacidosis the 2024 consensus moves to a basal–bolus regimen, with basal insulin given 1–2 hours before the infusion stops.

text.zh-CN: 继续静脉胰岛素，等 HbA1c 和 C 肽结果都出来、看清他是否需要长期用胰岛素，再决定下一步
text.en: Keep the insulin infusion running until the HbA1c and C-peptide results come back and show whether he needs long-term insulin at all

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。酮症酸中毒已纠正、能够进食时，没有理由继续静脉输注；HbA1c 和 C 肽用于分型，但酮症酸中毒之后无论哪一型，胰岛素都要继续，直到证明不再需要。2024 年共识此时转为皮下基础–餐时方案，基础胰岛素在停输注前 1–2 小时给予。
feedback.en: No. Once ketoacidosis has resolved and he can eat there is no reason to stay on an infusion; the HbA1c and C-peptide will classify his diabetes, but after DKA insulin continues whatever the type until it is shown to be unnecessary. The 2024 consensus moves to subcutaneous basal–bolus insulin at this point, with basal insulin given 1–2 hours before the infusion stops.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院次日 HbA1c 6.8%；酸中毒纠正后空腹 C 肽 50 pmol/L，餐后 2 小时 70 pmol/L；GAD、ICA、IAA 抗体均阴性。从开始口渴到酮症酸中毒共 5 天，以前没人说过他有糖尿病，家里也没有人得糖尿病。怎样给他的糖尿病分型？
prompt.en: The day after admission his HbA1c is 6.8 %; after the acidosis was corrected his C-peptide was 50 pmol/L fasting and 70 pmol/L 2 hours after a meal; GAD, ICA and IAA antibodies are negative. Five days passed from the first thirst to ketoacidosis; nobody had told him he had diabetes, and no one in his family has it. How do you classify his diabetes?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3，并在病房阶段阅读 HbA1c、C 肽和胰岛自身抗体结果。
need.en: First complete decision 3, then read the HbA1c, C-peptide and islet antibody results on the ward.

text.zh-CN: 暴发性 1 型糖尿病：起病 1 周内酮症酸中毒，血糖 ≥ 16.0 mmol/L 而 HbA1c < 8.7%，C 肽低于界值，需终身胰岛素
text.en: Fulminant type 1 diabetes: ketoacidosis within a week of onset, glucose ≥ 16.0 mmol/L with HbA1c below 8.7 %, C-peptide below the cut-offs — lifelong insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准：高血糖症状出现后约 1 周内发生酮症或酮症酸中毒（他为 5 天）；初诊血糖 ≥ 16.0 mmol/L（23.8）且 HbA1c < 8.7%（NGSP，6.8%）；空腹 C 肽 < 0.10 nmol/L（50 pmol/L）且餐后或胰高糖素刺激后 < 0.17 nmol/L（70 pmol/L）。三条都满足；这一亚型胰岛自身抗体通常阴性，β 细胞几乎完全破坏，胰岛素要终身使用。
feedback.en: Correct. The Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria: ketosis or ketoacidosis within about a week of hyperglycaemic symptoms (five days here); glucose ≥ 16.0 mmol/L at presentation (23.8) with HbA1c below 8.7 % NGSP (6.8 %); fasting C-peptide below 0.10 nmol/L (50 pmol/L) with a post-meal or post-glucagon value below 0.17 nmol/L (70 pmol/L). He meets all three; islet antibodies are usually negative in this subtype, β-cell loss is near-total, and insulin is lifelong.

text.zh-CN: 酮症倾向 2 型糖尿病：胰岛抗体阴性、HbA1c 只有 6.8%，说明高糖毒性解除后他自己的胰岛功能会逐步恢复，几周后就可以改为口服降糖药治疗
text.en: Ketosis-prone type 2 diabetes: negative antibodies and an HbA1c of only 6.8 % mean his insulin secretion will recover, so tablets can replace insulin within weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。酮症倾向 2 型糖尿病在高糖毒性解除后保留可测的胰岛素分泌，部分患者以后可以停胰岛素；他的空腹 C 肽 50 pmol/L、餐后 70 pmol/L，远低于日本糖尿病学会 2012 年暴发性标准的界值。血糖 23.8 mmol/L 时 HbA1c 只有 6.8%，提示病程极短，而不是糖尿病很轻。
feedback.en: No. Ketosis-prone type 2 diabetes keeps measurable insulin secretion once glucose toxicity settles, so some patients can later stop insulin; his C-peptide of 50 pmol/L fasting and 70 pmol/L after a meal is far below the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 fulminant cut-offs. An HbA1c of only 6.8 % alongside a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L points to a very short illness, not to mild diabetes.

text.zh-CN: 经典自身免疫性 1 型糖尿病：年轻、偏瘦、明显缺乏胰岛素，抗体阴性和只有几天的病程都不影响这个判断
text.en: Classic autoimmune type 1 diabetes: young, lean and insulin-deficient, whatever the negative antibodies and the few days of symptoms

feedback.zh-CN: 不是最佳答案。经典自身免疫性 1 型糖尿病通常在数周到数月内起病，诊断时 HbA1c 往往更高，多数患者胰岛自身抗体阳性；5 天的病程、HbA1c 6.8%、GAD/ICA/IAA 阴性和几乎测不到的 C 肽，按日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准属于暴发性亚型。区分它有意义：不要指望“蜜月期”，从第一天起就需要胰岛素。
feedback.en: Not the best answer. Classic autoimmune type 1 diabetes usually develops over weeks to months, so HbA1c is usually higher at diagnosis and most patients have islet autoantibodies; a five-day course, an HbA1c of 6.8 %, negative GAD, ICA and IAA and near-absent C-peptide make this the fulminant subtype by the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria. The distinction matters: expect no honeymoon — insulin is needed from day one.

text.zh-CN: 单基因糖尿病（MODY）：年轻、偏瘦且胰岛抗体阴性，应先做基因检测，并先试用磺脲类药物
text.en: Monogenic diabetes (MODY): a lean young adult with negative islet antibodies, so arrange genetic testing and try a sulfonylurea first

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。MODY 通常多代家族聚集、保留胰岛素分泌，很少以酮症酸中毒起病；他没有糖尿病家族史，以酮症酸中毒起病，C 肽几乎测不到，符合日本糖尿病学会 2012 年暴发性 1 型标准。试用磺脲类会让一个缺乏胰岛素的人失去胰岛素治疗。
feedback.en: No. MODY usually runs through several generations and keeps insulin secretion, so it rarely presents in ketoacidosis; he has no family history of diabetes, presented in ketoacidosis and has near-absent C-peptide, which fits the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 fulminant type 1 criteria. A sulfonylurea trial would leave an insulin-deficient man without insulin.

text.zh-CN: 应激性高血糖：呕吐和脱水引起的一过性血糖升高，出院前停胰岛素，再复查血糖
text.en: Stress hyperglycaemia from the vomiting and dehydration: stop insulin before discharge and recheck his glucose

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。应激性高血糖不会造成尿酮体 +++ 伴 HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L；血糖 23.8 mmol/L 伴酸中毒和酮症已符合 2024 年共识的糖尿病酮症酸中毒定义，本身就意味着糖尿病。对 C 肽只有 50 pmol/L 的人停胰岛素，会让酮症酸中毒再次发生。
feedback.en: No. Stress hyperglycaemia does not produce ketonuria +++ with a bicarbonate of 7.1 mmol/L; a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L with ketosis and acidosis meets the 2024 consensus definition of DKA, which is diabetes by definition. Stopping insulin in a man whose C-peptide is 50 pmol/L would bring the ketoacidosis back.

prompt.zh-CN: 多次复查血常规：血红蛋白 110.7–126 g/L，持续小细胞性改变；HbA2 4.6%；β 珠蛋白基因（HBB）第 17 位密码子杂合突变。哪些内容应写进他的计划？（多选）
prompt.en: His repeated blood counts show haemoglobin 110.7–126 g/L with persistent microcytosis; HbA2 is 4.6 % and he is heterozygous for an HBB (β-globin) codon 17 variant. Which of these belong in his plan? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先完成分型（决策 4），并阅读血常规、血红蛋白电泳和外送基因检测结果。
need.en: First classify his diabetes (decision 4) and read the blood count, haemoglobin electrophoresis and send-away genetic test results.

text.zh-CN: 暴发性 1 型糖尿病的诊断不变：起病时间和 C 肽两条标准都不依赖 HbA1c
text.en: The fulminant type 1 diagnosis stands: its timing and C-peptide criteria do not depend on HbA1c

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准中只有 HbA1c < 8.7% 一条与血红蛋白有关；5 天的起病时间和 50、70 pmol/L 的 C 肽各自成立。即使携带状态使 HbA1c 有偏差，改变的也只是一条支持证据的分量，而不是诊断。
feedback.en: Correct. Of the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria only the HbA1c below 8.7 % involves haemoglobin; the five-day onset and the C-peptide of 50 and 70 pmol/L stand on their own. If his trait biases HbA1c, it changes the weight of one supporting criterion, not the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 用指尖血糖或持续葡萄糖监测评估控制，需要时查糖化白蛋白或果糖胺，并请检验科说明其 HbA1c 方法是否受影响
text.en: Judge his control by meter or continuous glucose monitoring, with glycated albumin or fructosamine if needed, and ask the laboratory whether its HbA1c method is affected

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ADA 2026 年诊疗标准和 2023 年糖尿病实验室指南（Sacks 等）指出，血红蛋白变异和红细胞寿命改变可使 HbA1c 失真，偏差方向取决于检测方法；此时用血糖仪或 CGM 数据，必要时加果糖胺或糖化白蛋白评估控制。他的 HbA1c 方法没有记录，6.8% 和 3 个月时的 6.9% 都不能直接当真。
feedback.en: Correct. The ADA Standards of Care 2026 and the 2023 laboratory guideline (Sacks et al.) warn that haemoglobin variants and altered red-cell survival can make HbA1c misleading, in a direction that depends on the assay; meter or CGM glucose data, with fructosamine or glycated albumin, then judge control. His HbA1c method is not recorded, so neither the 6.8 % nor the 6.9 % at three months can be taken at face value.

text.zh-CN: 告诉他是 β 地中海贫血携带者，建议将来的配偶在怀孕前检测，并为他的亲属提供检测
text.en: Explain that he carries β-thalassaemia trait, and offer testing to a future partner before a pregnancy and to his relatives

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。HbA2 4.6% 加 HBB 杂合突变、血红蛋白 110.7–126 g/L，是 β 地中海贫血携带状态（轻型），不是疾病本身。若将来配偶也是携带者，每次怀孕有 1/4 的机会生下重型 β 地中海贫血患儿，所以应在遗传咨询下为配偶和亲属提供检测（BSH 2023）。
feedback.en: Correct. HbA2 of 4.6 % with a heterozygous HBB variant and a haemoglobin of 110.7–126 g/L is β-thalassaemia trait — a carrier state, not the disease. If a future partner is also a carrier, each pregnancy carries a 1 in 4 chance of a child with β-thalassaemia major, so partner and family testing are offered with genetic counselling (BSH 2023).

text.zh-CN: 针对持续的小细胞性改变开始口服铁剂，3 个月后复查血常规
text.en: Start oral iron for the persistent microcytosis and recheck the blood count in three months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。本病例没有显示缺铁——没有记录铁蛋白或铁代谢指标；小细胞性改变可以由 β 地中海贫血携带状态解释，补铁纠正不了。铁剂只用于证实的缺铁，先查铁蛋白；缺铁还会压低 HbA2，影响携带者的判断（BSH 2023）。
feedback.en: No. No iron deficiency is shown — no ferritin or iron studies are recorded — and the microcytosis is explained by β-thalassaemia trait, which iron does not correct. Iron is for proven deficiency, so check ferritin first; iron deficiency also lowers HbA2 and can blur the carrier diagnosis (BSH 2023).

text.zh-CN: HbA1c 6.8% 已经达到 7% 的常用目标，可以减少他的胰岛素用量
text.en: Reduce his insulin, since an HbA1c of 6.8 % already meets the usual target of 7 %

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这次 HbA1c 是在他起病不到一周时测的，主要反映起病前几周的血糖，又可能受携带状态影响，说明不了现在的控制，更不能用来减胰岛素。他的 C 肽几乎测不到，胰岛素剂量应按血糖监测结果调整（ADA 2026 年诊疗标准）。
feedback.en: No. This HbA1c was taken less than a week into his illness, so it mostly reflects the weeks before it, and it may be biased by his trait: it says nothing about control and cannot justify cutting insulin. His C-peptide is near-absent; insulin doses follow his glucose readings (ADA Standards of Care 2026).

text.zh-CN: 问清口渴、多尿和呕吐的起病与经过，既往有无糖尿病、糖尿病家族史，以及用药和过敏
text.en: Took the onset and course of the thirst, polyuria and vomiting, any previous diabetes, the family history of diabetes, and his medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 评估一般情况、生命体征、脱水程度，并闻了呼出气
text.en: Assessed his general appearance, vital signs and hydration, and smelled his breath

text.zh-CN: 在急诊读取血糖、尿酮体、血气和肾功能电解质
text.en: In the ED, read the glucose, urine ketones, blood gas and kidney function with electrolytes

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为需要监护床位的糖尿病酮症酸中毒，并在急诊请上级评估、联系监护床位
text.en: Recognised diabetic ketoacidosis needing a monitored bed at the first attempt, and asked for senior review and a monitored bed while in the ED

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选定第一小时的补液、胰岛素和补钾方案，并写下强化监测计划
text.en: Chose the first-hour fluid, insulin and potassium plan at the first attempt and charted an intensive monitoring plan

text.zh-CN: 仍在急诊阶段时实际开始了等渗补液和固定速率静脉胰岛素
text.en: Actually started isotonic fluid and a fixed-rate intravenous insulin infusion while he was still in the ED

text.zh-CN: 血钾 6.23 mmol/L 时在急诊做了心电图并持续心电监护，没有对着这个血钾往液体里加钾
text.en: With potassium at 6.23 mmol/L, recorded an ECG and started continuous ECG monitoring in the ED, and added no potassium to the fluids against that value

text.zh-CN: 没有给碳酸氢钠、低渗盐水、代替静脉输注的皮下胰岛素、只按血糖追加的胰岛素、口服降糖药或铁剂，也没有在基础胰岛素之前停掉静脉胰岛素
text.en: Gave no bicarbonate, hypotonic saline, subcutaneous insulin in place of the infusion, correction-only insulin, oral glucose-lowering tablets or iron, and did not stop the infusion before basal insulin

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确安排撤离静脉胰岛素，并开始了皮下胰岛素（基础胰岛素或胰岛素泵）
text.en: Planned the move off the insulin infusion correctly at the first attempt and started subcutaneous insulin (basal insulin or a pump)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准完成分型
text.en: Classified his diabetes by the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下携带状态下的血糖评估与咨询计划，并安排遗传咨询和糖尿病教育
text.en: Set the glucose-assessment and counselling plan for his carrier state at the first attempt, and arranged genetic counselling and diabetes education

text.zh-CN: 向他解释急诊处理、新诊断的糖尿病和携带状态，并确认他听懂了
text.en: Explained the emergency treatment, the new diagnosis of diabetes and his carrier state to him, and checked that he understood

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先了解他觉得自己怎么了，正面回应“是不是吃坏肚子”的担心；用通俗的话说明这是血糖太高、身体缺胰岛素引起的酸中毒，需要静脉输液、胰岛素泵入、反复抽血和心电监护，并说明为什么暂时不补钾。到了病房，说明这是一种起病很急的 1 型糖尿病，自身几乎不再分泌胰岛素，需要终身用胰岛素（回应他“以后是不是离不开胰岛素”的担心，不作虚假保证）；讲清生病时不能停胰岛素、要查血酮、何时就医，以及低血糖的识别和处理；解释他是 β 地中海贫血携带者，为什么 HbA1c 可能不准、要改看血糖记录，并说明将来配偶检测和家人检测的意义。用复述确认理解，留出提问时间，说明接下来的安排；不编造病例中没有记录的结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves, first finds out what he thinks is wrong and answers his worry that it is a stomach bug honestly; explains in plain words that his blood sugar is very high because his body lacks insulin, that this has made his blood acidic, and that he needs a drip, an insulin infusion, repeated blood tests and heart monitoring — including why potassium is not being added yet. On the ward, explains a sudden-onset form of type 1 diabetes in which his own insulin has almost stopped, so insulin is lifelong (meeting his worry about needing insulin every day without false reassurance); covers never stopping insulin when ill, checking ketones and when to seek help, and recognising and treating hypoglycaemia; explains that he carries β-thalassaemia trait, why his HbA1c may mislead and glucose records are used instead, and why a future partner and his relatives may want testing. Checks understanding by teach-back, leaves room for questions and says what happens next; invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 急诊抢救区护士，之后跟着病例到病房。交班（ISBAR）：24岁男性，口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天，急性病容；分诊手测体温 36.7 ℃、脉搏 106 次/分、呼吸 25 次/分、血压 106/59 mmHg。抢救区床旁有血糖仪和血酮仪、监护仪、心电图机、输液泵和抢救车（留置针、常用药）；化验在床旁采血送检。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的操作；往任何液体里加钾之前，先问医生最新的血钾和他是否已上监护。只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到体重、血氧、意识评分或尿量时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: ED resus nurse who follows the case to the ward. Handover (ISBAR): a 24-year-old man with five days of thirst and polyuria and three days of nausea and vomiting, acutely unwell; triage readings T 36.7 °C, pulse 106/min, RR 25/min, BP 106/59 mmHg. At the resus bedside: a glucose and ketone meter, the monitor, the ECG machine, infusion pumps and the crash cart (cannulas, common drugs); bloods are taken at the patient and sent. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; before adding potassium to any bag she asks the doctor for the latest potassium and whether he is on the monitor. Reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked for his weight, oxygen saturation, conscious-level score or urine output, she says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never a number.

name.zh-CN: 严医生（内分泌科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“没有烂苹果味，能排除酮症酸中毒吗？”“pH 和 HCO₃⁻ 落在不同的严重程度分级，你按哪个处理？”“血钾高，体内总钾是高还是低？什么时候开始补钾？”“血钠按血糖校正后是多少？有效渗透压呢？这对选液体意味着什么？”“为什么这里不用碳酸氢钠？”“血气正常了，就能停输注吗？还缺什么？”“血糖那么高而 HbA1c 不高，有哪两种解释？”“病程、C 肽和抗体放在一起，你怎么分型？”“携带状态会怎样影响 HbA1c？诊断还站得住吗？”。可以讲解 2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识、JBDS-IP 2023、日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准、ADA 2026 年诊疗标准和 2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南的相关原则；学员读到相应记录后，可以指出报告的病程（记录了补液和胰岛素、次日用胰岛素泵，没有记录治疗地点、血酮和补钾）与现行做法的差别。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（体重身高、意识、血氧、血酮、氯、心电图、胰酶、治疗方案、MCV 数值、HbA1c 方法都没有记录），也不解读结局记录。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Does the absence of fruity breath exclude ketoacidosis?”, “The pH and the bicarbonate fall in different severity bands — which do you treat?”, “His potassium is high: is his total-body potassium high or low, and when does potassium go in?”, “What is his sodium once corrected for the glucose, and his effective osmolality — what does that mean for the choice of fluid?”, “Why no bicarbonate here?”, “The gas is normal — can the infusion stop? What is missing?”, “A glucose that high with an HbA1c that modest — what are the two explanations?”, “Put the time course, the C-peptide and the antibodies together: how do you classify him?”, “How could his carrier state affect HbA1c — and does the diagnosis still stand?”. May explain the relevant principles of the 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus, JBDS-IP 2023, the Japan Diabetes Society 2012 criteria, the ADA Standards of Care 2026 and the 2014 European hyponatraemia guideline, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded course (fluids and insulin, a pump from the next day; no place of care, ketone values or potassium recorded) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits; adds no data the case lacks (weight and height, conscious level, oxygen saturation, blood ketones, chloride, ECG, pancreatic enzymes, the regimen, the MCV value and the HbA1c method are not recorded), and does not interpret the outcome record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科会诊医生，学员看过血常规后参与。只解读学员已经读过的血常规、血红蛋白电泳、珠蛋白基因和铁代谢结果：携带状态与疾病的区别、HbA2 升高的意义、缺铁会压低 HbA2、为什么不能凭小细胞性改变就补铁、“第 17 位密码子”的传统编号与 HGVS 编号的对应、携带者咨询与配偶检测，以及 HbA1c 方法如何受血红蛋白变异影响。指出报告中 MCV 的单位前后不一致、本病例不给出数值。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造 MCV、MCH、HbF、铁蛋白、α 珠蛋白基因或具体核苷酸改变（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Haematology consultant who joins once the learner has looked at the blood count. Interprets only the blood counts, haemoglobin electrophoresis, globin gene and iron results the learner has read: carrier state versus disease, what a raised HbA2 means, how iron deficiency lowers HbA2, why microcytosis alone does not justify iron, how the legacy “codon 17” maps to HGVS numbering, carrier counselling and partner testing, and how haemoglobin variants affect HbA1c methods. Points out that the report's MCV unit is inconsistent, so the case gives no number. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents an MCV, MCH, HbF, ferritin, α-globin result or exact nucleotide change (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：急诊酮症酸中毒、暴发起病的分型，以及血红蛋白携带状态对 HbA1c 的影响
title.en: Debrief: ketoacidosis in the ED, a fulminant onset, and what a haemoglobin trait does to HbA1c

conclusion.zh-CN: 24岁男性（BMI 17.62 kg/m²），口渴、多尿 5 天，恶心呕吐 3 天；脉搏 106 次/分，呼吸 25 次/分，血压 106/59 mmHg，皮肤干燥，呼出气没有烂苹果味。血糖 23.8 mmol/L、尿酮体 +++、pH 7.173、HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L，确立糖尿病酮症酸中毒，按 HCO₃⁻ 属重度；同时有钾 6.23、钠 117.05 mmol/L（校正后约 122–125）和肌酐 179 μmol/L。补液和胰岛素治疗 12 小时后 pH 7.375、HCO₃⁻ 20 mmol/L，次日开始胰岛素泵。入院次日 HbA1c 6.8%，C 肽 50/70 pmol/L，GAD、ICA、IAA 阴性，符合日本糖尿病学会 2012 年暴发性 1 型糖尿病标准。持续小细胞性改变、HbA2 4.6% 和 HBB 第 17 位密码子杂合突变提示 β 地中海贫血携带状态，可使 HbA1c 失真，但诊断依靠起病时间和 C 肽仍然成立。3 个月时 HbA1c 6.9%，C 肽仍低。今天的做法：等渗补液，0.1 U/(kg·h) 静脉胰岛素，血钾高时在心电监护下暂不补钾，不用碳酸氢钠，停输注前先给基础胰岛素，用血糖监测而非 HbA1c 评估控制，并提供携带者咨询。
conclusion.en: A 24-year-old man (BMI 17.62 kg/m²): five days of thirst and polyuria, three of vomiting; pulse 106/min, RR 25/min, BP 106/59 mmHg, dry skin, no fruity breath. Glucose 23.8 mmol/L, urine ketones +++, pH 7.173 and bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L made it diabetic ketoacidosis, severe by its bicarbonate, with K⁺ 6.23, Na⁺ 117.05 mmol/L (≈ 122–125 corrected) and creatinine 179 μmol/L. After 12 hours of fluids and insulin: pH 7.375, bicarbonate 20 mmol/L; a pump from the next day. HbA1c 6.8 %, C-peptide 50/70 pmol/L and negative GAD, ICA and IAA met the JDS 2012 criteria for fulminant type 1 diabetes. Microcytosis, HbA2 4.6 % and a heterozygous HBB codon 17 variant showed β-thalassaemia trait, which can bias HbA1c; the diagnosis rests on onset and C-peptide. At three months: HbA1c 6.9 %, C-peptide still low. Today: isotonic fluid, insulin 0.1 units/kg/h, potassium withheld under monitoring, no bicarbonate, basal insulin before stopping the infusion, glucose-based monitoring, carrier counselling.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 年轻人口渴、多尿几天后开始呕吐，心率和呼吸都快、皮肤干燥：先考虑高血糖危象，马上查血糖和酮体，而不是先按胃肠炎处理。
keyReasoning.en: Days of thirst and polyuria followed by vomiting in a young man who is tachycardic, tachypnoeic and dry put a hyperglycaemic crisis first: check glucose and ketones at once rather than treating 'gastroenteritis'.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖 23.8 mmol/L、尿酮体 +++、pH 7.173、HCO₃⁻ 7.1 mmol/L 就是糖尿病酮症酸中毒；HCO₃⁻ 在重度范围，加上高钾、低钠和肌酐升高，需要监护床位——没有烂苹果味不改变任何判断。
keyReasoning.en: Glucose 23.8 mmol/L, ketonuria +++, pH 7.173 and bicarbonate 7.1 mmol/L are DKA; a bicarbonate in the severe band with high potassium, low sodium and a raised creatinine needs a monitored bed — the absent fruity breath changes nothing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血钾 6.23 mmol/L 是酸中毒和缺胰岛素造成的细胞内钾外移，体内总钾其实偏低：先补液、上胰岛素、做心电监护，血钾降下来再补；血钠 117.05 mmol/L 校正后仍低，所以只用等渗液。
keyReasoning.en: A potassium of 6.23 mmol/L reflects potassium shifted out of cells by acidosis and insulin lack, over a low total-body store: fluids, insulin and ECG monitoring first, potassium only as it falls; the sodium of 117.05 mmol/L stays low once corrected, so only isotonic fluid.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 12 小时 pH 7.375、HCO₃⁻ 20 mmol/L 说明酸中毒已纠正；停输注前还要确认血酮、能进食，并先让皮下基础胰岛素起效。
keyReasoning.en: At 12 hours pH 7.375 and bicarbonate 20 mmol/L show the acidosis has cleared; before the infusion stops, ketones and eating must be confirmed and subcutaneous basal insulin must already be working.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 5 天的病程、血糖 23.8 mmol/L 而 HbA1c 只有 6.8%、C 肽 50/70 pmol/L、抗体阴性，指向暴发性 1 型糖尿病；β 地中海贫血携带状态只削弱 HbA1c 这一条，不动摇起病时间和 C 肽两条。
keyReasoning.en: A five-day course, a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L with an HbA1c of only 6.8 %, C-peptide of 50/70 pmol/L and negative antibodies point to fulminant type 1 diabetes; β-thalassaemia trait weakens only the HbA1c criterion, not the timing or the C-peptide.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别并分级酮症酸中毒。2024 年 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS 共识：血糖 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L 或已知糖尿病，β-羟丁酸 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L（JBDS-IP 2023 也接受尿酮体 ++ 及以上），pH < 7.3 和/或 HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L；轻度 pH > 7.25 且 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 15，中度 pH 7.0–7.25、HCO₃⁻ 10 至 < 15，重度 pH < 7.0、HCO₃⁻ < 10 mmol/L，分级决定治疗地点。他的 pH 属中度、HCO₃⁻ 属重度；没有烂苹果味和呕吐突出都不能改变诊断。报告与现行做法：报告记录了补液和胰岛素，没有记录治疗地点和任何血酮值。
teachingPoints.en: Recognise and grade DKA. The 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS-IP/AACE/DTS consensus: glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L or known diabetes, β-hydroxybutyrate ≥ 3.0 mmol/L (JBDS-IP 2023 also accepts urine ketones ++ or more), and pH < 7.3 and/or bicarbonate < 18 mmol/L; mild is pH > 7.25 with bicarbonate ≥ 15, moderate pH 7.0–7.25 with bicarbonate 10 to < 15, severe pH < 7.0 with bicarbonate < 10 mmol/L, and the grade sets the place of care. His pH is moderate but his bicarbonate severe; neither the absent fruity breath nor the prominent vomiting changes the diagnosis. Then and now: the report records fluids and insulin, but not where he was treated or any ketone value.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 第一小时：补液、胰岛素、钾。2024 年共识：等渗盐水或平衡晶体液最初 2–4 小时 500–1000 mL/h；固定速率静脉胰岛素 0.1 U/(kg·h)；血糖 < 13.9 mmol/L 时加 5%–10% 葡萄糖，胰岛素持续到酮体清除；血钾 < 5.0 mmol/L 才补钾（JBDS-IP 2023：5.5），< 3.5 mmol/L 时推迟胰岛素；pH < 7.0 才考虑碳酸氢钠。血钾 6.23 mmol/L、肌酐 179 μmol/L 时，要心电监护和复查血钾，不能第一袋就加钾。报告与现行做法：报告没有记录方案，只记录 12 小时后 pH 7.375、HCO₃⁻ 20 mmol/L。
teachingPoints.en: The first hour: fluids, insulin, potassium. The 2024 consensus: isotonic saline or a balanced crystalloid at 500–1,000 mL/h for 2–4 hours; a fixed-rate intravenous insulin infusion at 0.1 units/kg/h; 5–10 % glucose added below 13.9 mmol/L with insulin continued until ketones clear; potassium only once it is below 5.0 mmol/L (5.5 in JBDS-IP 2023) and insulin delayed below 3.5 mmol/L; bicarbonate only below pH 7.0. At K⁺ 6.23 mmol/L with a creatinine of 179 μmol/L: ECG monitoring and repeat potassium — never potassium in the first bag. Then and now: the report gives no regimen, only pH 7.375 and bicarbonate 20 mmol/L at 12 hours.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 结合血糖看血钠。血钠 117.05 mmol/L、血糖 23.8 mmol/L 时，校正血钠约 122 mmol/L（每高出 5.6 mmol/L 血糖加 1.6）或 125 mmol/L（加 2.4），仍是真性低钠；有效渗透压（2 × 钠 + 血糖）约 258 mOsm/kg。所以只用等渗液、不用 0.45% 盐水；每 2–4 小时同时查血钠和血糖，预期血糖下降时实测血钠上升；可用血气分析仪（直接电极）复核血钠，排除脂血造成的假性低钠；校正血钠的上升参照慢性低钠血症，24 小时内不超过约 10 mmol/L（2014 年欧洲低钠血症指南）。本病例没有记录此后的血钠。
teachingPoints.en: Read the sodium with the glucose. A sodium of 117.05 mmol/L with a glucose of 23.8 mmol/L corrects to about 122 mmol/L (adding 1.6 per 5.6 mmol/L of glucose above normal) or 125 mmol/L (adding 2.4) — still a true hyponatraemia — and the effective osmolality (2 × Na⁺ + glucose) is about 258 mOsm/kg. So: isotonic fluid only, never 0.45 % saline; sodium and glucose every 2–4 hours, expecting the measured sodium to rise as the glucose falls; a blood-gas (direct electrode) sodium to exclude pseudohyponatraemia from a lipaemic sample; and a rise in corrected sodium kept within about 10 mmol/L in the first 24 hours, as for chronic hyponatraemia (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014). No later sodium is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 撤离静脉胰岛素。2024 年共识的纠正标准是血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L 且静脉 pH ≥ 7.3 或 HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L；停输注前至少 1–2 小时给皮下基础胰岛素，之后用基础–餐时方案。他 12 小时的 pH 和 HCO₃⁻ 已达标，但没有记录血酮。报告与现行做法：2010 年的团队次日开始用胰岛素泵；无论长期用注射还是胰岛素泵，都要等皮下胰岛素起效再停输注，并配合胰岛素使用、低血糖处理和病假时监测血酮的结构化教育。
teachingPoints.en: Come off the infusion safely. The 2024 consensus defines resolution as ketones < 0.6 mmol/L with venous pH ≥ 7.3 or bicarbonate ≥ 18 mmol/L, gives subcutaneous basal insulin at least 1–2 hours before the infusion stops, and continues a basal–bolus regimen. His 12-hour pH and bicarbonate met the thresholds, but no ketone value is recorded. Then and now: the 2010 team began pump treatment the next day; whether injections or a pump follow, the infusion stops only once subcutaneous insulin is working, with structured education on insulin, hypoglycaemia and sick-day ketone checks.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 暴发性 1 型糖尿病（日本糖尿病学会 2012 年标准）：高血糖症状出现约 7 天内发生酮症或酮症酸中毒；初诊血糖 ≥ 16.0 mmol/L 且 HbA1c < 8.7%（NGSP；既往已知糖耐量异常者不适用这条）；空腹 C 肽 < 0.10 nmol/L、餐后或胰高糖素刺激后 < 0.17 nmol/L。他的数值：5 天；23.8 mmol/L 和 6.8%；50 和 70 pmol/L。胰岛自身抗体通常阴性，胰岛素需终身使用。报告与现行做法：报告发表于 2010 年，早于 2012 年修订，当时的界值是 HbA1c < 8.5%（JDS 值）；他的 6.8% 两种界值都满足。
teachingPoints.en: Fulminant type 1 diabetes (Japan Diabetes Society 2012): ketosis or ketoacidosis within about 7 days of hyperglycaemic symptoms; glucose ≥ 16.0 mmol/L with HbA1c < 8.7 % (NGSP) at presentation — not applicable when glucose intolerance was known before; fasting C-peptide < 0.10 nmol/L and post-meal or post-glucagon < 0.17 nmol/L. His values: five days; 23.8 mmol/L and 6.8 %; 50 and 70 pmol/L. Islet antibodies are usually negative, and insulin is lifelong. Then and now: the report (2010) predates the 2012 revision, when the cut-off was HbA1c < 8.5 % (JDS value); his 6.8 % meets either.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 携带状态下的 HbA1c。HbA2 4.6% 加 HBB 第 17 位密码子杂合突变是 β 地中海贫血携带状态。血红蛋白变异和红细胞寿命改变可使 HbA1c 偏高或偏低，取决于检测方法（ADA 2026 年诊疗标准；Sacks 等 2023 年实验室指南）；他的 6.8%（及 3 个月时的 6.9%）方法不明，只能作为暴发性诊断的支持证据，不能用来调胰岛素——改看血糖仪或 CGM、果糖胺或糖化白蛋白。没有证实缺铁不补铁（缺铁还会压低 HbA2），并为配偶和亲属提供携带者咨询和检测（BSH 2023）。
teachingPoints.en: HbA1c in a haemoglobin trait. HbA2 of 4.6 % with a heterozygous HBB codon 17 variant is β-thalassaemia trait. Haemoglobin variants and altered red-cell survival can push HbA1c up or down depending on the method (ADA Standards of Care 2026; Sacks et al. 2023 laboratory guideline), so his 6.8 % (and 6.9 % at three months), by an unrecorded method, can support the fulminant diagnosis but cannot guide insulin: use meter or CGM glucose, fructosamine or glycated albumin. No iron without proven deficiency (deficiency also lowers HbA2), and carrier counselling with partner and family testing (BSH 2023).

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明 β 地中海贫血携带状态使他的 HbA1c 偏高还是偏低、偏多少，也不能证明某种治疗方案更好；没有记录的体征、化验和治疗细节保持未知。决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show whether, or by how much, his β-thalassaemia trait biased his HbA1c, or that any regimen is better than another; unrecorded signs, tests and treatment details stay unknown. The decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.
